title: Diagnose and cut checks-stage time with per-crate timings
summary: Find why the checks stage (fmt, clippy, tests) grew ~35% for 3% more tests, using per-crate/per-test timings on the base build, then fix the main cause (slow new tests or build growth) so the full check run is at least 15% faster than 1176s, with the same tests passing. Audience: the maintainer watching check_timeout_s margin. Scope is this one diagnosis-and-fix plus a CHANGELOG entry.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check the checks stage time and passing tests, not the activity.
cargo test and clippy -D warnings must pass.
Cause named with timings and fix targets it.
Timings are measured and cited in the CHANGELOG.
One diagnosis and fix; other work left as follow-ups.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs (checks stage entry, runs fmt, clippy, test in order under check_timeout_s) and crates/athena-data/src/config.rs; crate set is crates/athena-{agent,cap-change,cap-study,cli,context,core,data,gate,git,score}. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are not touched.

Cause is unknown; likely candidates are slow integration tests (e.g. crates/athena-cli/tests/) that spawn processes, sleep, or rebuild, or lost build sharing between crates. The producer measures with cargo test -- --report-time or equivalent, before and after.
Fix keeps every test and its coverage; speedups come from removing sleeps/real waits, sharing fixtures, or avoiding rebuilds, not from deleting tests.
Wall-clock gains in the 15% target are measured by the same checks stage; the verifier can only run cargo test/clippy/fmt --check, so timing evidence is the recorded check output.
Follow-up requests, not this job: changing check_timeout_s in athena.toml, restructuring the checks stage, parallelizing stages.

acceptance_criteria.text: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry naming the cause of the checks slowdown and the fix, with per-crate or per-test timings before and after on the base build.
The change removes no tests: the test count after the change is at least the 1737 tests before, and no test is deleted or marked #[ignore] (checkable with git diff).
Run `cargo test` on the candidate: all tests pass, the same set as before.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`: both clean.
The recorded check output of the candidate shows the full checks stage at or below 1000s (at least 15% under the slowest run, 1176s), measured by the same checks stage.
The diff shows the slow tests or build steps identified in the CHANGELOG entry are the ones changed (cause matches the fix, root cause not a symptom).

out_of_scope: Changing check_timeout_s or other values in athena.toml
Restructuring or parallelizing the pipeline stages
departures: Open-ended diagnosis with a measured speedup target raises cost and failure risk; wall time kept within verifier_timeout_s by narrowing scope.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time in the checks stage, the slowest serial stage of every job, and shrinks timeout risk.
